column3: A couple's resort getaway to rekindle their spark takes a turn when Sophie Dee, the woman on the next lounger, decides they need a teacher. Every resort activity becomes a lesson, and every lesson goes further.
Tru Kait borrowed her sister’s husband to help her move. It’s hard to keep your eyes on the road with a passenger like that. And let’s just say moving is the last thing on her mind.

You're doing it wrong. That’s Lexi Luna talking, standing over you, sweat on her chest. Your wife says: do whatever she says. So you do... behind her back. Lexi wants to see how long you last.. who’s getting a workout? You! By Lexi Luna!
You failed the swim test to be a lifeguard. Your married boss passed you anyway. Now she’s collecting, but her jealous rival and the hottest girl in the club wants you first.

column2: Our Neighbor's Wife Locked Herself Out
column3: His neighbor’s wife locks herself out after a run. Her husband is away on a work trip, his own wife is at work until evening, and the locksmith can’t come until tonight. She waits at his place all day.
Nick's stepsister is getting married in seven days. She catches him staring at her in the wedding dress, pulls him inside, and starts what they have never done in years.

column2: My Fiancée’s Mom Booked the Cabin Next Door
column3: A pre-wedding cruise with his fiancée and her mother. On day one his fiancée gets seasick and is stuck in their cabin all week. Her mother and her mother’s two girlfriends take a close interest in keeping him company.
A sexy honeymoon shoot turns dangerous when the photographer is your ex, and she wants you back before your new wife finds out…

column2: My Wife's Little Stepsister Was My Date
column3: Faye borrows her stepsister’s husband, Josh, as a fake date to her ex’s wedding. Her plan is simple: ruin the ceremony and find out if Josh is really as “safe” as her stepsister believes.

A romantic resort getaway takes an unexpected turn when a couple’s private cabana is double-booked with his girlfriend’s stepsister and her flirtatious best friend. Think double booking means double trouble? You have no idea.
Mom sent him to chaperone his bratty stepsister’s Miami spring break. Her best friend wants him first. Gigi won’t share — until the flight home.

column2: My Girlfriend's Mom Is Staying With Us
column3: Her mom moves into their spare room for two weeks during a kitchen renovation. His girlfriend works long days. Twenty years married to a man who never noticed her, the mom sees that her daughter’s boyfriend does.

column2: My Blind Date Was My Best Friend’s Mom
column3: My best friend’s mom showed up to my blind date and made me promise to keep a secret.

His girlfriend's sister and stepsister keep him at the house to decorate for her surprise party while their mom keeps her busy across town. There's one job left, the streamers in her bedroom, and both of them want to be the one who helps.
A married man drives the babysitter, Lea, home, and she doesn’t want to say goodnight. His wife has her own idea about where Lea belongs.
He is the live-in super. The tenant in 4B is twenty, married young, husband deployed. She keeps finding things that need fixing. Her friend Rhea is staying with her—and she’s noticed too.

Max and Luna haven’t touched in three months. She’s packed to leave. One house call with sexologist Corinne Kettering: nobody breaks up until one perfect night—and she grades it. She teaches him how to look. Luna stops wanting out.

column2: My Young Stepmom Got Stood Up
column3: His dad stood up his young stepmom on their anniversary. She’s already in the dress, and she heard what Evan said about it. Now she wants him to unzip it before Dad arrives home in an hour.

Twenty minutes before the vows, Harriet's ex walks into the bridal suite and she locks the door, takes what she wants and marries the groom anyway. By nightfall there are three people in the wedding bed and only one of them is in charge.

column2: I Can’t Believe My Stepsister Is A Stripper
column3: A rideshare driver accidentally discovers his stepsister’s secret: she’s a stripper. Her way of keeping him quiet? The full VIP treatment. Now he’s hooked, she’s breaking every rule, and her mom still thinks she’s just a waitress.

column2: TR:Truth or Dare With My Stepsister
column3: Home alone for the night, a bratty stepsister turns Truth or Dare into a game her stepbrother can't stop playing.

His wife flies out for two days and asks him to look after Bella, her daughter. Bella always calls him Daddy, and she has her own idea of what looking after her means. Two days, one house, and a flight that gets cancelled.

Alma throws a slumber party for her college friends, leaving her stepbrother off the guest list. But when she decides to invite him into the fun, the night takes an unexpected turn, especially when their curious neighbor joins the party.
He can join his girlfriend in the shower, or stay behind with her stepsister. He makes the wrong choice.

Jake is newly married to Sabrina. Her hot stepsister Jesse, who has always been extremely close to her, moves in for a while. From Jake's point of view, the tension builds as he goes out of his way to get closer to Jesse while she teases him.

The new stepfather is asked by his traditional Asian partner to bring her rebellious, fully Americanized nerdy daughter back in line. His discipline sparks a charged friction that slowly turns into desire, all inside the family home.

David crashes Tori's wedding, finds her alone in the bridal suite still hungry for him, and one reckless moment in her dress turns into an ongoing secret affair while her naive new husband watches from the sidelines.

When his girlfriend’s seductive identical twin arrives for a visit, a devoted boyfriend is pulled into a game of temptation that tests his loyalty, leading to secret affairs with both sisters before their equally alluring mother comes home
She catches him with her dirty panties and tells him she is going to teach him a lesson in respect.

When a 37-year-old stepmom invites her 20-year-old stepson on a business trip after her husband cancels, forbidden attraction explodes into steamy hotel encounters until the husband shows up unannounced.

A bold therapist treats a struggling couple by inserting herself into their sessions and their private life. Jake and Tessa came for advice. Margot Vey gives them hands-on lessons instead that blur the line between treatment and temptation.
Dad is away until Thursday. His stepmom put him in the room across from hers, shared bathroom, and left her door open on purpose. He says they can't. She says she knows exactly who she is.

A 20-year-old guy visits his older stepsister, Riley, for a weekend at her all-girl college dorm, where every room presents a new sexual adventure, bringing himself and his stepsister Riley closer than ever before.

column2: I Couldn't Say No to Our Babysitter
column3: After her date cancels, the Hartleys’ babysitter takes a ride home — and turns a married man’s courtesy into a question he can’t answer with his wedding band on the wheel.

column2: TR:Spa Day With My Girlfriend's Stepmom
column3: Lily books her mom a couples spa weekend for her birthday. Then she gets called in to work and sends her boyfriend Josh instead. The resort assumes they are a couple, and Kara doesn't correct anyone.

column2: I Drove My Girlfriend's Stepsister To College
column3: Hanna asks her boyfriend to drive her stepsister Kenzie to college. But studying is the last thing on Kenzie’s mind.

When her husband, the company’s CEO, pulls out of the client trip, Gia takes a young associate instead. One suite, one bed, and a deal that depends on the lie that they are married. Everything quickly turns into more than just pretend.

column2: My Young Stepmom Needs a Date
column3: A man is left home alone with his very hot young stepmom. She hears exactly what he wants and turns his staring into a private invitation.
His fiancée’s best friend hates him — until wedding week proves she’s wanted him all along.
His stepmom catches him failing at school, then decides the only way to fix his grades is to give him a hands-on lesson herself.
A booking mix-up turns a quiet weekend getaway into an unexpected shared vacation when two couples discover they've rented the same mountain cabin.

He rents his spare room to make the mortgage. After one girl moves in, another shows up vying for the spot. His girlfriend is on her way home, but right now, both girls plan to do anything to be the new tenant.
When their plans for a night out fall through, Sp00kybby and her stepbro are forced to spend a night at home and learn more about each other in one night than they ever imagined.
At a family reunion on the ranch, Lea meets her intriguing new step-cousin, Jake. With her boyfriend preoccupied, she decides to have a little fun—and get to know Jake much better.

column2: My Girlfriend's Little Sister Moved In
column3: His girlfriend's little sister, a gymnast, moves in for a month to prepare for her biggest competition. She stretches in her room every morning while the girlfriend is at work. She's noticed how he looks at her. She likes it.
When a shy, curvy new temp starts at his London office, the boss quickly becomes obsessed — while his hot, jealous blonde PA will do anything to destroy their forbidden fling.

On the wedding day, the bride's younger sister, the maid of honor, has two hours to get the groom before he says "I do." The bride is getting ready in the bedroom and can't come out, because it's bad luck for the groom to see her.

You're the lowest recruit on base until Sgt. Diana Demont pulls you out of the mud and claims you as hers. She's the untouchable CO married to the Colonel who owns everything — and you're the only one who sees the woman under the uniform.
A trophy stepmom waiting by the pool. A CEO stepdad busy at work. A secret the son never saw coming. It starts in private and ends in a full party with the CEO's friends.

column2: Full Treatment: At The Spa With My Girlfriend's Stepmom
column3: When work ruins Alma’s plans to celebrate her stepmom Nicole’s birthday at a spa resort, she sends her boyfriend instead. After all, someone has to entertain the birthday girl!

column2: TR:My Stepsister Is Back - Bonnie Blue
column3: She caught him sniffing her panties, and smiled. What starts as stepbrother Jake's secret obsession becomes Bonnie's game: tease, taste, and take him further. The private heat goes public when her friends find out. Five episodes. No brakes.

Left home alone for the afternoon, your stepsister Mona unleashes her wild side, starting a journey of sexual passion and discovery. When you get caught in the act, you realize her naughty instincts come straight from your stepmom!
Mother-in-law cancels his bachelor party in front of the whole family. An hour later, with her daughter asleep upstairs, she offers a private “gift” instead and her two friends walk in the back door.
Your stepsister just turned 21. You’re home for summer break. All she wants for her birthday… is you.

column2: Truth or Dare With Emma Hix
column3: Nick’s stepsister Emma and her best friend Rhea drag him into Truth or Dare in the basement while the parents are upstairs. Every dare points at him. Emma keeps raising the stakes.

Your stepmom put you across the hall and left her door open, while your dad's gone away for a work trip till Thursday. She's in charge and you can't stop looking. "Go to sleep, baby." And if you don't, she's going to stop being good.

column2: My Girlfriend's Mom Needs A Ride
column3: My girlfriend asked me to drive her mom, Diana home from work, and she made sure it didn’t end at her front door. Her mom's car’s in the shop all week and she is in desperate need of a ride.

column2: My Stepmom Sophie Dee Caught Me Changing
column3: My stepmom walked in while I was changing. She saw everything. Then she showed up in my room in almost nothing while my dad is downstairs.
Theo fantasizes about his goth neighbors, then he and his wife lure them into a private BDSM club.

column2: My Bachelor Gift was My Fiancée's Mom
column3: Your fiancée just said NO to a bachelor party. No strippers, no wild night, no last hurrah. But her Mother has other plans.. and what she's throwing you is a secret party you'll NEVER be able to tell anyone about. EVER.

column2: My Girlfriend Paid for My Massage
column3: For their anniversary, Camilla books a couples spa day, then "accidentally" gets them separate rooms. Ben's masseuse has been told to give him the full experience. Through the thin wall, he can hear that Camilla booked the same for herself.

Her husband thinks he's the pool guy. He's not. When her best friend lets herself in and finds him in the hallway with his hoodie inside out, the wife invents "rules of our marriage" on the spot and the friend decides she wants to play too.

column2: My Wedding Date Was My Girlfriend's Mom
column3: Maddie is the maid of honor, so her mom, Corinne, takes Maddie's boyfriend as her wedding date. One hotel, one night. Corinne's sister Rosa sees everything. Maddie is always one door away.

column2: My Girlfriend's Mom Read My Texts
column3: On a long holiday weekend at his girlfriend's family lake house, Ethan leaves his phone on the kitchen island. Her mother, Jessie, reads all 43 messages he sent his friends about her, and now she wants him to prove he meant every one.
A flirtation with his fiancée's mother spirals into an irresistible affair during a lakeside holiday. But when almost caught on the brink of betrayal, unexpected events threaten to expose everything.

Your new stepdaughter is naughty. You caught her climbing in the window at 2am. You kept it a secret. And now she’s paying you back in ways her mom would never allow. There’s only one thing left to say to her: “Don't tell your mother!”

When their newlywed parents leave for a week, cocky 24-year-old Cole can’t stop calling out the way his new stepsister Lea keeps staring at him. She insists she can’t stand him… then dares him to prove she wants more.

column2: One-Night Stand Is My Friend's Stepmom
column3: After a one-night stand in Cabo, three weeks later your best friend’s stepmom opens the door - and the only rule in the house is: don’t let him hear.

Any officer who touches the new police chief is fired and charged. So when Chief Vera Lancaster puts the rookie nobody wanted on her night detail, every shift is a career on the line, and she keeps daring him to break the rule.
His wife booked the babysitter. She never asked what the babysitter would do with her husband once the kids were asleep.
Professor Mia's private counseling session turns a student's punishment into a forbidden affair, until the dean catches them and demands her share of the discipline.

column2: My Girlfriend Caught Me With A Groupie
column3: Sienna will do anything to get close to Jax, the rockstar she’s obsessed with. His manager-girlfriend controls access and decides to test her first. What starts as a screening in the dressing room turns into something much more hands-on.

column2: I Couldn't Say No To My Stepsister
column3: Every Sunday, Danny and his stepsister Delilah come home from college for family dinner at their parents' house in the suburbs. Delilah, 21, a bratty girl with mint-green hair, has some fun on her mind, and it includes her stepbrother.

column2: My Stepsister Still Calls Me Loser
column3: The girl who called Ethan a loser all through college is back. His dad just married her mom, so Sadie is now his stepsister. They share a bathroom, and she never locks the door.

column2: My Neighbor Stopped Closing The Blinds
column3: Every morning Brandi stretches on her deck with the blinds open, fully aware her neighbor is watching. Her husband works nights and sleeps all day. Brandi knows that her neighbor is there and she likes being seen.

column2: My Fiancée's Sister Was My Wedding Present
column3: Your fiancée's little sister is Lana Rhoades and she just threw you the bachelor party your fiancée banned. Now three of her hottest friends are taking care of you...and Lana's done watching.

column2: My Mother-In-Law Wants To Be My Hall Pass
column3: At family dinner, Kate tells her mom she trusts her husband so much she'd give him a hall pass, because he'd never use it. Everyone laughs. Her mother, Margot, doesn't. She corners Dan in the kitchen ten minutes later, with an idea.

Nate's roommate Ben has a girlfriend who sleeps over every weekend. Sadie, 23, says Nate is the worst: rude, cocky, always in a towel, always saying what nobody else will. What he says most is that Ben is boring and she knows it.

column2: Always Open: My Girlfriend's Stepsister Caught Me Looking
column3: Leo moved into his girlfriend’s house. Her stepsister Sadie leaves her door open and counts how often he looks. She catches him once. After that the invite is permanent. Gym nights. Open doors. A girlfriend who still trusts him. For now.

He picks his girlfriend’s stepsister up from the airport; by the time stepsis calls, they already need a cover. Home for Christmas, Kenzie, in a filthy little Santa costume, slips him a gift meant for after midnight.

column2: My Girlfriend’s Step-Sister Caught Me Staring
column3: Jake gets caught staring at his girlfriend's sister mid-change. What starts as embarrassment becomes a private game — one she keeps escalating right under her sister's nose, testing how far he'll go.
You and your wife Diana book a "quiet family campground by the lake." Turns out, it's a private couples' campground, and everyone knows the rules except for you.
Ava's fiancé can't make any of the wedding prep, so her stepbrother Leo stands in for him: the vows, the kiss, the dress, and the wedding night...

You're on your yearly company retreat, and your boss, Kara, wants you on her desk. While your coworker, Lucy, wants you in her bed. Neither of them is willing to share. Your review isn’t finished until you get one of them...or both?

column2: My New Stepmom Used to Be a Stripper
column3: Jake’s dad comes home with a new wife, and Jake recognizes her instantly: the stripper who danced for him at his best friend’s Vegas bachelor party. She’ll do anything to keep him quiet, starting with one last private dance.

When Lexi's stepson gets bullied at university, she confronts the jock at his place, only to find him attractive. She strikes a reckless deal to stop the bullying. The secret arrangement spirals out of control.

You’re home from college & your dad’s new wife is a blonde bombshell. Dad’s asleep by ten. But she isn't. Then she’s at your door with more than towels. However she’s not the only one who wants you. Your stepmom + your flirty ex, at once?

column2: Lena The Plug Stole My Boyfriend
column3: Delilah and Ryan hit an empty beach house for spring break. Best friend Lena lands a day early and wants him on sight. By the weekend Delilah isn’t just watching—she’s in it with them.

column2: My Girlfriend’s Stepsister Left the Door Open
column3: Noah gets caught staring at his girlfriend's stepsister mid-change. She doesn't cover up — she makes it a game, played right under her sister's nose: a hallway, a jacket with the keys in it, a closet, and one blanket over three laps.

column2: My One-Night Stand Is My Girlfriend's Mom
column3: After sleeping with a stranger in Miami, three weeks later, your one-night stand answers the door as your girlfriend's mother — and the only rule tonight is: don't let her daughter hear.

column2: Mum Got Sick On Our Holiday
column3: You're the step-dad. She's 23, nervous and turned on. Your wife's one floor up, texting you to keep her daughter happy. But Harriet has her own idea of happy. Can you give her what she wants before your wife finds out?

column2: My Best Friend's Mom Teaches Pilates
column3: His best friend gifts him ten pilates sessions with the woman who 'fixed his back' — his own mother. Session one, her hands are on him. Session two, she locks the door after close. And Tyler is never more than ten minutes away.

column2: My Brother's Wife Needs A Ride
column3: His older brother leaves for a six-week offshore rotation the same week his wife’s car dies, so he asks Danny to drive for her. While her husband's away, his wife will play.
Your dad’s gone for two weeks. Your stepmom can’t walk, can’t undress, can’t get into bed without your hands all over her. And every night she asks for a little more. How long can you say no?
Five years married, fifth year at the same hotel. His wife takes twenty-minute showers. Room service knows.
Seeking shelter from a storm, you stumble into a remote chapel, where two dangerously deprived nuns are eager to show their first man in years some thoroughly unholy hospitality.

column2: My Wife's Stepmom Has One Rule!
column3: Nothing Hidden. That’s the house rule, and your wife’s smoking hot stepmom means it. Open doors, no locks.. and a trunk full of S&M toys. Tonight your wife hands you to her. Blindfolded. You won’t see them coming... but you’ll feel it!

column2: My Stepsister Plays Hard To Get
column3: Kayla says her stepbrother Cole has zero chance—pervert, not her type. One car ride, one load of dishes, one night out later, she’s not so sure. Then the neighbor walks in… and wants in.

column2: TR:My Girlfriend's Step-Aunt Is Asa Akira
column3: Chris meets his girlfriend Lily's family at dinner, including her uncle's new wife, Asa. While Lily stays close by, the bold step-aunt starts a risky, escalating seduction right under her nose.
Seven days before his royal wedding, the prince’s step-cousin Lady Antonella rides in to watch him say his vows, and she won’t let him forget the night they spent together.

Halloween night in an ordinary suburban house. Lamp-lit living room, cheap decorations, music still playing. The husband and his wife are hosting a casual costume party. His step-sister shows up early in a too-small cupid costume.

Bratty college stepdaughter Lana turns her stepdad Marcus's discipline into a secret obsession. What starts at home escalates into dorm dares with her friend Delilah, Marcus's girlfriend Sandra and shy cameraman Jerry.
His girlfriend left the door unlocked, and the yoga teacher he’s been watching through the window just walked in to give him a private class.

column2: Three Nights With My Wife's Best Friend
column3: His wife's best friend got dumped on Thursday. By Friday she's on their couch till Sunday, in his hoodie. His wife is always one wall away — in bed, in the shower, at the door. The friend decided on night one she isn't leaving without him.

column2: My Girlfriend’s Sister Kept Me After Class
column3: David signed up for night class because his girlfriend's sister teaches it. His girlfriend is in pottery class, three doors down and drives him home at ten. There's so much to learn until then.

Jake, 35, breaks both hands. His wife books a home nurse — 'some sixty-year-old grandma' — and leaves for work. Mila walks in: 30, blonde, blue uniform, top button open. Everything he can't do, she does. And his wife never sees her.
Lana catches her stepbrother watching her latest video and uses it as an excuse to turn him into an adult video star.

Danny’s stuck for a week at his girlfriend’s family home while she works double shifts. Her stepmom Diana wants him gone. Her plan to break him has one flaw: every test he passes makes her want him more.
His sexy personal trainer has five days to make him cheat, and she’s doing it while his fiancée waits outside the door.
Nicole runs her company with two rules: never lie to her, and never get out of line. He breaks rule one on the first day. Breaking rule two is where the fun starts.
An attempt to get back with your ex is thwarted by her hot Mom, who wants you all to herself.

Ava hosts girls’ night and banishes her boyfriend to the bedroom. Twenty minutes into the movie, she’s asleep on the couch. Her best friend—and his stepsister—Camilla comes for him with fun in mind: “You’re allowed now, stepbro.”

His new stepsister brings her boyfriend’s ‘69 Camaro to his garage three days before a car show. Three shops couldn’t fix it. He does it in ten minutes. It leaves Sunday, and so does she. First, she wants the back seat.
Lana Rhoades runs the sorority house on campus, and it has one rule: no boys allowed. So naturally, she moves her stepbrother in.

column2: Got Stuck With My Girlfriend's Stepmom
column3: A boyfriend gets trapped in a house with his girlfriend’s stepmom. She starts testing whether he will stay loyal to her daughter.
A young woman enters therapy to stop obsessing over the man living in her mother’s house — and discovers the therapist, the mother, and both sisters are already writing his desire like a script.
His wife hires a young maid and leaves for work. From nine to eight it is just the two of them in the house...
She's your girlfriend's little sister, but she's so hot, you can't help but notice her. You've caught her watching you too, and you've decided you have to have her.
His girlfriend told him to behave on his first day, but the new girl lured him to her dorm room, locked the door, and had no intention of going to class.
Dad's away until Thursday and calls every night at nine. Jake's home for spring break, his stepmom Gia gave him the room across from hers, and her side of the shared bathroom door never locks.

She knows it's wrong. So does he. Under the same roof as her mother, eager stepdaughter Riley Reid teases her reluctant stepdad Mark until neither of them can resist. The risks are high, but the rewards are even higher...
Tyler's dad just walked out on his stepmom Josie for a 24-year-old. Tyler, 22, comes home for the weekend to keep her company through the worst of it.
A husband and his wife's sister play 18 holes for a bet where the winner decides what the loser does. By the 9th hole, they're not playing golf anymore. By the 18th, their spouses aren't either.
Ben and Emily tour their first home. The realtor shows him every room alone—while his wife is always one door away. By the time they sign, the deal isn’t the only thing that closed.

It's Mila's first day as a stewardess on a billionaire's superyacht, and she's sure the owner would never look twice at a girl like her. He does. His chief stew, Vera, has waited three years for him to notice her.

column2: The Nun in Our Guest Room
column3: Seven days before she gives herself to God, she has one more thing she wants to take for herself first.

His son’s fiancée moves in ten days before the wedding and keeps asking Mark for his opinion on everything. With his wife always in the next room, she wants her future father-in-law to see her properly before she says I do.

When the husbands leave for work, the plumber starts his real round. Every house has a different woman waiting. Different bodies, different levels of hunger, different rules. He is the neighborhood’s open secret.

Chubby and awkward Harriet is surprised when the chief of surgery locks the on-call door and gives her some very "hands-on training," while the jealous head nurse who wants her fired is waiting right outside.
A king trapped in a cold political marriage falls for the servant sent to dress him each morning, and in a castle where the Queen hears everything, the girl from the kitchens wants more than his bed.

At a small town church, the new priest faces temptation from a young college-aged parishioner. Torn between his vows and his attraction to the young woman, the priest enters into an illicit affair that could cost him his flock.

column2: My Girlfriend's Therapist Caught On Cam
column3: Your girlfriend books an intimacy coach to fix your love life. The therapist decides you're not the problem, sends her to the waiting room with the door left open, and begins the real sessions on camera while she watches in secret.
When his girlfriend brings a shy foreign exchange student named Mica Sarasola to live with them for a semester, a guy finds out she's looking to learn more than just English.

column2: My Girlfriend's Sister Just Got Divorced
column3: My girlfriend's older sister moved into our spare room for two weeks, divorced, restless, and impossible to ignore.

Halloween night. Dorm supervisor on duty. His stepsister shows up in a devil costume with a game: every knock means he picks trick or treat. Their parents arrive at midnight. Five hours. One room. No running this time.

column2: I Won My Best Friend's Girlfriend
column3: Sofia, her boyfriend, and the friend who was only supposed to fix a computer. She never meant to fall for him, but revenge tastes too good to pass...

column2: My Fiancée’s Mother Is My Hall Pass
column3: Days before the wedding, Avery gives Cole one free night with anyone, as long as she never knows who. Her mother Vera hears every word. With her husband one room away, Vera decides the pass is hers.

column2: Boss Paid Me to Watch His Wife
column3: Boss paid me to watch his wife. One night by the pool turned into something neither of us planned. Now his calls won’t stop, and every time I try to leave… she asks me to stay.

Mona can’t stand her smug, mess-making stepbrother, yet she’s always nosing around when he's by, and won't ever waste an opportunity to tease him - perhaps all the tension needs some sort of release...

Touching the queen is punishable by death. So when the 22-year-old queen picks the lowest-born guard in the castle to stand outside her bedchamber, every night becomes a death sentence, and she keeps daring him.

column2: Thanksgiving With My Best Friend's Mom
column3: Ryan has nowhere to go for Thanksgiving, so his best friend Kyle brings him home. Kyle's mom, Lexi Luna, is cooking the big dinner. While the men watch football in the living room, she keeps pulling Ryan into the kitchen.
My best friend begged me to protect his daughter from all the wrong men — he never guessed the wrong man was me.

Mom turns 50 on Saturday. Her daughter has a surprise planned, and it starts with her stepdad. Party planning turns into guest-room heat, and by the time they hit the upstairs hallway, there’s no holding back. Then Aunt Sarah arrives.

Your dad goes on a work trip and puts his 22-year-old wife Ava in charge of the house, and of you. "Whatever your mom says, you do." She takes it literally, and wants to take you next. And you can't say no.

column2: Bachelor Party with My Fiancée's Mother
column3: Two weeks before the wedding, his fiancée says no to a bachelor party and leaves him alone with her mother, a former dancer who says every groom deserves a proper send-off. He never says yes. He just can't say no.

column2: A Woman's World - The Last Man On Earth
column3: Deep in the ruins of a fallen civilization, the last man on Earth discovers a hidden enclave of women ruled by a dangerously seductive queen, who sees his arrival not as a miracle, but as a prize to be shared among her restless subjects.
Quinn visits her step-brother and his girlfriend for a month and turns one secret kiss into a cheating addiction he can’t stop.
My wife booked tango lessons to save our marriage. Then she stopped coming. Now the instructor’s private routine feels like an affair—still called choreography. For now.
A professor keeps a failing student after class for staring at her, turning his "focus problem" into intimate night lessons — one rule: he only says "Yes, Professor." His girlfriend catches them...
After a clumsy accident brings them closer a rebellious girl and her stepbrother spiral into a secret romance that eventually pulls their stepmom into the ultimate taboo triangle.

column2: The Gods Gave Me My Father's Wife
column3: Prince Theron comes home to a new stepmother—Queen Lysandra, the woman from his dreams. Shared visions pull them into a forbidden affair until they're caught, banned, and offered both wife and crown by the king who could never please her.

column2: I Dated My Best Friend Mom
column3: Jake swipes right on his best friend's mom as a joke, she matches first. One night turns into a secret he can't undo, and when her daughter shows up knowing everything, he's trapped between two women and one door that won't stay shut.

A beautiful, popular college girl shares an apartment with a socially awkward roommate she constantly teases, manipulates, and uses for attention. What starts as harmless teasing slowly becomes an addictive emotional game where every interaction feels like a reward…or a punishment.

Your stepsister's about to get married. Tonight's her bachelorette party, and she's dragging YOU along. She's A TOTAL TEASE, and so are her THREE girlfriends. What does the bride want on her last night of freedom? To be unzipped... BY YOU!
A junior male employee is publicly disciplined and privately selected by the married woman who controls his career.
